Alice: Heads-up — saw a weird growth pattern in KV cache during longctx replay test this morning. memory climbs steadily then drops in big steps, but throughput stays fine.

Ben: Can you paste the flame/profile? is it the runtime or allocator?

Alice: quick paste: allocation heatmap shows many small entries with similar prefixes, eviction rate spikes right before the drop. looks like fragmentation + paging by the OS.

Carmen: interesting — I ran a quick tracer. KV key cardinality for that tenant is ~3x higher than expected because we weren’t normalizing user-provided prefixes. lots of near-duplicates: "user:123:prompt" vs "user:123:prompt\n" (trailing newline).

Marta: also saw increased page faults in iostat around the same window. when prefix reuse drops, resident set steps down.

Ben: can you share the cache key generation snippet? maybe hash salt varies per request.

Alice: snippet: ```python
def make_kv_key(prefix, session_id, seq):
    return f"{tenant}:{session_id}:{prefix}:{seq}"  # naive
```

Carmen: ah — session_id is ephemeral for some clients. that kills reuse. suggestion: canonicalize prefix and make session part optional for prefix-level caching.

Marta: +1. also propose a small TTL bump for prefetched prefixes (from 30s -> 2min) during longctx workloads to reduce churn and avoid immediate eviction.

Ben: curious about sticky routing impact — when requests land on different workers the same prefix creates distinct local caches. we should measure cross-worker reuse coefficient.

Alice: did a synthetic: cross-worker prefix reuse ~18% vs intra-worker ~72% for the workload. so routing dominates.

Carmen: quick mitigation options: 1) normalize keys (trim, collapse whitespace), 2) remove session_id from prefix-level key, 3) increase small-entry slab size or > run compaction more aggressively, 4) add metric for "prefix-coalesced-hit-rate".

Marta: for paging: enable memory accounting hooks to surface page-faults per cache-shard. I can add a debug flag to the runtime.

Alice: I rolled a small change to canonicalize prefixes in a feature branch. will run full replay later today.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: branch alice/kv-prefix-normalize -> stg at 2026-03-18T12:42:00Z :rocket:

Ben: follow-up: for longctx growth we should investigate allocator fragmentation. maybe move many small KV entries into a compacted arena for long-lived prefixes.

Carmen: agreed. I'll sketch a compacting slab design and estimate perf cost.

Alice: action items: Marta adds page-fault metrics, Ben proto of compact arena, Carmen design doc for key canonicalization + compaction, I’ll run replay and post results. owner tags set.

Marta: tagging me as owner for paging metrics.

Ben: assigning me for compact arena prototype.

Carmen: will create a short doc and PR for prefix canonicalization.

Alice: thanks — if replay validates, we can avoid a bigger eviction/paging incident in prod. :thumbsup:
